_deal: The mission board's test node, as 12a and 20a.
author: jessica
source: his 2026-10-17 09:51: "do the next 5 as well, Json is cheap". First Delve of the old MB20 Sabotage (books) family. Old MB20a: 'A cache of banned texts has turned up. The order is destruction, not confiscation, and nobody has offered a reason.'
_note: THE BANNED TEXTS. The old line's best part is the missing reason, so the Delve keeps it missing and lets the
player read one before burning. Two uses, in order: open the cache, then burn it. No choice offered: the job is
the job, and the journal is where the player gets to have a feeling about it. No fight (quiet site).
Issuer: an administrator's office, flat and unexplained (style guide 33 s4). Single ending, so the last use's say
is the closing radio (his 2026-10-17). Pay: easy, placeholder; the tier is his.

place._theme: A quiet site, as 20a: nobody shoots, the job is the burning.

prose.name: Sabotage: Banned Texts on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A cache of banned texts has turned up at the <Place>. The posting wants them burned, not collected, and doesn't say why.
prose.card: Administrative Contract. A cache of prohibited texts has been located at the <Place> on <Planet>. Destroy the material on site. Do not remove or copy it. Payment on contract completion.

beats.objective: Find the cache of texts at the <Place>
beats.journal: The cache at the <Place> is a footlocker of hand-bound books. I read the first page of the top one. It's a cookbook, mostly, with a family's names written in the margins.
beats.name: Cache of Banned Texts

beats.journal: I burned the cache at the <Place>, every book in it. I still don't know what was banned about them. Nobody asked me to know.
say: Destruction confirmed. Your report is filed. There is nothing further on this contract.

broadcast: Contract confirmed. The material is to be destroyed on site. Do not read it, remove it or copy it.
_speech: The office on the radio, flat as a form. 'Do not read it' is said once and the journal reads it anyway. Recast 2026-10-22 off Matilda (his: "very robotic") to ElevenLabs' 'Alice, Clear, Engaging Educator', british: clear and official without the robot. Alice then ruled out of the whole cast by his ear 2026-10-27 ("sounds like a phone system instead of a person"); recast to Annie K, heard in game on 32a. His ear decides.
